name: Vesuvio
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Campania appellation around Ercolano, Torre del Greco and Boscotrecase, for still, sparkling and liqueur wine. Its whites are led by Caprettone and Coda di Volpe and its reds by Piedirosso. Its white, red and rosé blends may be labeled Lacryma Christi.
